bundle_inventory.exclusion_reason: source manifest is self-referential and bound by manifest_sha256
bundle_inventory.included_artifacts: every regular file recursively below source root

minimum_snapshot_scope: Complete official BindingDB Articles payload plus assay, reaction-set mapping, target FASTA, and polymer-to-UniProt mapping bytes. The Articles payload is origin-mixed; no row was canonically admitted.
